Claim 1 (Currently amended): A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said columnar body has a cross-section that is one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open and the columnar body has a cross-section that is one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon.

Claim 5 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, and at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section, and at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

Claim 11 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base, and said base member is configured to provide a means for electrical connection.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 150 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline, wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said body.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face, and said diode is configured to emit light in a direction substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.
